name: Round Timer
desc: Heavy-bag round timer: warm-up, rounds and breaks, with a combo for each round.
about: Set a warm-up, the number of rounds and the round and break lengths in 15-second steps. The clock fills the screen and turns green for a round, orange with 30 seconds left and red at 10. Each round gets a heavy-bag combo, shown during the break before it, and a stats page follows the session.

intents.desc: Rounds, breaks and a combo for each round, with the clock filling the screen.

intents.phrase: …get a combo to work on each round
intents.desc: A bank of 35 heavy-bag combos, one per round, with the ones that hurt left out.
